## VIC constituent redistribution: the solved mass change as face transfers, moved donor-upwind (`vic_constituent_column`) {#sec-ch07-vic-redistribute}

### Summary

The implicit system knows only the total density $\rho$ (@sec-ch07-vic-sweep). Applying its correction to each species
in proportion to the cell's own mass fraction would not conserve a species over the column when the mass
fractions vary with height. It also could not carry a composition contrast. So the correction is converted into
the unique set of face transfers that produces it, and the constituents ride on those transfers.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Turns the solved change of the total density $\rho$ into mass transfers through the faces of the column, then moves
dry gas, each species and the passive scalars through those faces from the upwind cell, never more than the donor
holds; @eq-ch07-vic-faces.

**Data.** In, per cell $i$ of the column: the solved increment, its total-mass component $\delta\rho_i$ the change of the
total density $\rho$ [kg m$^{-3}$]; the total-density part of the explicit increment, $\Delta^{\mathrm{stg}}\rho_i$
[kg m$^{-3}$] (@sec-ch07-vic-stage); the cell mass $\rho_iV_i$ [kg] and volume $V_i$ [m$^3$]; the dry and species densities [kg m$^{-3}$]
(total-mass basis) and scalar densities $\rho_{\mathrm d}r_n$ [kg m$^{-3}$] (dry-mass basis). Out: the face mass
transfers $\mathcal T_{i+1/2}$ [kg] at the $x_1$ faces and the final tendencies of density, species and scalars [kg m$^{-3}$]
per cell, and the dry-clamp mark. Check cases: 50 random columns, a face asking for more than its donor holds, the
margin in both precisions.

**Placement.** Every stage with a VIC, after the sweep.

**Activation.** None; always on with the VIC.

**Guarantee / limits.** Conservative; donor-upwind, first order in the composition.

**Evidence.** Test: column totals of each constituent are kept, face transfers are single-valued and final masses are
non-negative, {{< code tests/test_backward_substitution.cpp vic_redistribution.conserves_constituent_column_tendencies >}}
($10^{-12}$ absolute); not run at the pin. Check: `python3 src/snapy_report/ch07/vic_redist_check.py`, output `vic_redist_check.out` lines `[C1]`–`[C5]`; the committed output prints PASS and the measured value of each claim, not the threshold it is held to, so the thresholds are **missing evidence** in the output; the check ports the code at the pin.
:::

### Derivation

The mass the solve adds to cell $i$ beyond the explicit increment is $(\delta\rho_i - \Delta^{\mathrm{stg}}\rho_i)V_i$, with
$\delta\rho_i$ the total-mass component of $\boldsymbol\delta_i$ and
$\Delta^{\mathrm{stg}}\rho_i = \Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}[\rho_{\mathrm d}]_i + \sum_n\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}[\rho_n]_i$ the total density of the
explicit increment; both are on the total-mass basis, as `explicit_total = DU(IDN) + sum DU(ICY+n)` in
`vic_constituent_column` ({{< code src/implicit/vic_redistribute_impl.h vic_constituent_column >}}). Let $\Delta M_{\mathrm{col}} = \sum_i(\delta\rho_i - \Delta^{\mathrm{stg}}\rho_i)V_i$ be the part with no closed-face
representation. The face transfers, positive upward, are

$$
\mathcal T_{-1/2} = 0 , \quad \mathcal T_{i+1/2} = \mathcal T_{i-1/2} - \Big((\delta\rho_i - \Delta^{\mathrm{stg}}\rho_i)V_i - \Delta M_{\mathrm{col}}\,\frac{\rho_iV_i}{\sum_{\mathrm{col}}\rho V}\Big) ,
$$ {#eq-ch07-vic-faces}

and they telescope: $\mathcal T$ at the top face is zero up to round-off, $10^{-15}$ of the largest transfer in the check
[check `src/snapy_report/ch07/vic_redist_check.py`, output `vic_redist_check.out`, `[C1]`]. Each constituent
then moves $\mathcal T_{i+1/2}$ times the mass fraction of the donor cell. The donor is cell $i$ for $\mathcal T>0$ and cell $i+1$
for $\mathcal T<0$. A transfer is clamped to what the donor holds after its explicit update and the transfers already
made. Every transfer is taken from one cell and given to the other. So dry gas and each species keep their
column total to $2\times10^{-16}$ (`[C2]`).

Without a clamp, each cell's total change is $\mathcal T_{i-1/2}-\mathcal T_{i+1/2}$, which is the bracket
of @eq-ch07-vic-faces (`[C3]`). The host measures how far the clamps moved the result from that identity, as the
"clamp residual". A face that asks for more than the donor holds empties the dry donor to round-off. The species
keep a margin of 4096 ulp, the dry clamp mark is set, and the residual shows the clamp (`[C4]`, `[C5]`).

In the code, @eq-ch07-vic-faces is the prefix sum into `MASS` ({{< code src/implicit/vic_redistribute_impl.h vic_constituent_column >}}).

### Numerical method

See @fig-ch07-vic-redistribute for one column of the check.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch07-vic-redistribute

Left: the cell mass changes $(\\delta\\rho_i - \\Delta^{\\mathrm{stg}}\\rho_i)V_i$ (sky blue) and the face transfers $\\mathcal T_{i-1/2}$ (orange) built from them by @eq-ch07-vic-faces, zero at the bottom and the top. Right: the resulting dry-gas (green) and species (purple, magnified 20 times) changes of each layer, moved donor-upwind."
#| fig-alt: "Two horizontal bar charts against layer number: on the left cell bars with a zig-zag line of face transfers starting and ending at zero; on the right paired green and purple bars."
#| echo: false

make_fig()
```

Pass 1 forms the cell mass changes, $\Delta M_{\mathrm{col}}$ and $\sum_{\mathrm{col}}\rho V$, through `explicit_total` ({{< code src/implicit/vic_redistribute_impl.h vic_constituent_column >}}).
Pass 2 is the prefix sum of @eq-ch07-vic-faces into `MASS` ({{< code src/implicit/vic_redistribute_impl.h vic_constituent_column >}}).
Pass 3a moves the dry gas with the dry fraction of the donor, carrying `dryfrac` upward
({{< code src/implicit/vic_redistribute_impl.h vic_constituent_column >}}). Where it clamps, it sets the mark that becomes the VIC clamp
cause of @sec-ch07-redo. Pass 3b moves each species, keeping `keep` $= 1 - 4096\epsilon_{\mathrm m}$ of the donor's
species density ({{< code src/implicit/vic_redistribute_impl.h vic_constituent_column >}}). `vic_redistribute_cell` then writes the
final tendencies: density plus the dry increment, the momenta and energy from $\boldsymbol\delta$, and the species
increments ({{< code src/implicit/vic_redistribute_impl.h vic_redistribute_cell >}}).

The CPU dispatch splits each column at solid cells and redistributes each fluid segment on its own, through
`vic_constituent_column` ({{< code src/implicit/implicit_dispatch.cpp vic_redistribute_cpu >}}). On CUDA the column passes are one
thread per column and the cell update one thread per cell. The host checks the clamp residual cell by cell into
`_clamp_residual` ({{< code src/implicit/implicit_hydro.cpp ImplicitHydroImpl::forward_masked >}}). The passive scalars, which are per dry mass,
move with the clamped dry-gas transfer from their donor cell, through `mass_corr`
({{< code src/mesh/meshblock.cpp MeshBlockImpl::advance_local >}}).

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
The constituents move donor-upwind, so a composition contrast is carried at first order and smeared. A clamp
breaks the link between the solved total and the cell totals; the clamp residual reports it and the dry clamp
mark asks for a redo.
:::

1. **Dry gas has no margin.** A drained dry donor can end at $-1$ ulp; the species keep 4096 ulp (`[C4]`).
2. **Residual share.** $\Delta M_{\mathrm{col}}$ is spread by cell mass, which puts most of it in the dense lower layers.
3. **Whole column on one rank.** The prefix sum assumes the column starts at a closed bottom on this rank
   (@sec-ch07-vic-options).
